title: Statically indeterminate five-bar truss: horizontal reaction

source.work: Bentley Systems, STAAD.Pro Help, Verification Examples (public documentation, docs.bentley.com)
source.edition: STAAD.Pro Help v21 build (pages refer to the STAAD.Pro 2023 sample files), read 2026-11-22
source.notes: problem statement taken from the vendor page (text and input listing). The page cites: Timoshenko, Strength of Materials, Part I, 3rd ed. 1956, p. 346, problem 3 - NOT opened for this project; no number is taken from it. The page's 'theory' values are recorded as printed; the program's own results are not used.

analysis: Plane truss (X-Y plane, Y vertical; uz of every joint held): joints 1 (0, 0), 2 (150, 100), 3 (150, 50), 4 (300, 0) in; bars 1-2 and 2-4 with A = 5 in^2, 1-3 and 3-4 with A = 3 in^2, 2-3 with A = 2 in^2; E = 30,000 ksi; joints 1 and 4 pinned; 10 kip downward at joint 2. Target of the page: the horizontal reaction. Reference values: computed here from this statement (verification/derive/vendor_reference.py); the textbook cited by the vendor page was not opened and no number is taken from it.
